title: Fuel Charging and Controls — 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS)
introduction:
This reference directs you to the fuel charging and controls explanation for the engine identified in the title. I treat it as a signpost in the manual: it tells you where the useful explanation lives, without making you hunt through the engine bay for an answer printed elsewhere.

Use the system-operation referral to learn how the system works together, and the component-description referral to learn what its individual parts do. Both lead to the same manual section. This page is a navigation reference; it contains no component inventory, operating sequence or diagnostic test. Keep the engine identification matched when consulting the referenced material.

edits.text: For the fuel charging and controls system’s operation, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. Read Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: Use the operating explanation to understand how the system’s functions fit together.
